dedupe_keys.name: rete geodetica della regione umbria monografie dei vertici e dei caposaldi

description: Rete geodetica della Regione Umbria (monografie dei vertici e dei caposaldi) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umbriageo.regione.umbria.it. The service allows you to consult and download the monographs of the bosses ordered by territorial scope, consult and download the monographs of the vertices by selecting the summits by municipality or number of summits. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic network of the Umbria Region (monographs of the summits and the cornerstones)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vertici, Rete geodetica planoaltimetrica, Caposaldi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
